title: Grain Position Note: The Holdback Taken on a Restated Membership and Patronage Equity Allocation While Bushels Stand Unpriced
content:
Bushels the member has delivered but never priced are bushels the cooperative has not yet sold, so a restatement made under Membership and Patronage Equity while they stand open is held back. The unpriced bushels are the ones standing on the member's grain ledger under their Grain Marketing Contracts, and they are set against the grain volume the restatement rests on.

**The heavier holdback.** Where the unpriced bushels standing on the member's grain ledger are more than a fifth of the grain volume restated, the restated allocation is taken at 0.85 of itself.

**The lighter holdback.** Where unpriced bushels stand on that ledger but are not more than a fifth of the grain volume restated, it is taken at 0.95 of itself.

**No holdback.** Where no unpriced bushels stand at all, no holdback is taken.

## Where the fifth falls, on hypothetical figures

| Grain volume restated | Unpriced bushels standing | Five times the unpriced bushels | The restated allocation is taken at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 30000.00 | 7500.00 | 37500.00, above the grain volume restated | 0.85 |
| 30000.00 | 6000.00 | 30000.00, exactly the grain volume restated and not above it | 0.95 |
| 30000.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00, under the grain volume restated | 0.95 |
| 30000.00 | none | none | itself |

Unpriced bushels coming to exactly a fifth of the grain volume restated are not more than a fifth, so 0.95 is the figure taken and not 0.85.

**Where the holdback acts.** It acts once on the whole restated allocation and not on any single basis, and the figure it gives is rounded to two decimal places. A restated allocation of 1800.00 taken at 0.85 gives 1530.00; taken at 0.95 it gives 1710.00.
